notes.title: ASSAULT SECTOR | Alpha Announcement
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=qsPBKGVGkQo;full][/previewyoutube]
We've been hard at work behind the scenes, pushing the game closer to [b]public playtests[/b] and preparing for the [b]demo release[/b]. Thank you for all the love and support!

We’re thrilled to announce that ASSAULT SECTOR has officially reached the [b]Alpha stage[/b] and is now ready to be showcased publicly. From this point forward, everyone will be able to participate in our playtests, as the [b]NDA restrictions[/b] limiting public access [b]have been lifted[/b].

As we evolved from pre-alpha to alpha over [b]2.5 years[/b], we've rebuilt key systems, optimized client and server performance, overhauled core mechanics, and added thousands of new content pieces to elevate the game.

Our team is very small, and we’re not a [b]AAA company[/b], but we're fully committed to delivering a[b] polished gaming experience[/b] that meets your high standards.

To showcase the alpha stage of ASSAULT SECTOR, check out our latest trailer. Your support means the world, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1568600/][b]Wishlist the game on Steam[/b][/url]  and [url=https://discord.gg/73heyWWSRE][b]follow us on Discord[/b][/url].

We’re dedicated to delivering a great game, and we couldn’t have come this far without you. Stay tuned for more updates!

Thank you again for your continued support and patience.
[b]Prepare for Battle, Conquer the Sector![/b]

Frag Pulse Team,
